description: All GateOnAI categories with their tool counts, or the tools of one category ordered by GateOnAI Score (free_only=true: the category's free-plan list). Same data as the site's category pages. Pricing model only, never prices.

category.description: Category slug, e.g. 'ai-agents'. Leave out for the list of categories.

free_only.description: Only tools with a free plan (the site's free-tools list)

limit.description: How many tools / items to return (default 10)

name: browse_categories

is_error.description: True if the tool could not complete the request

links.description: gateonai.com URLs referenced in the result, in order of appearance

markdown.description: The full result as Markdown (same as the text content), including GateOnAI's disclaimer

tool.description: Name of the tool that produced this result

title: Browse AI Tool Categories
